text:
Which statement about aqueous ethanoic acid is correct?
A
It reacts with magnesium to form oxygen gas.
B
It reacts with sodium carbonate to form carbon dioxide gas.
C
It turns red litmus paper blue.
D
It turns methyl orange yellow.

options.label: A
options.text: It reacts with magnesium to form oxygen gas.

options.label: B
options.text: It reacts with sodium carbonate to form carbon dioxide gas.

options.label: C
options.text: It turns red litmus paper blue.
